title: Tourist Season, 2016
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: A tourist recognizes the pup from the strip and cries. Wood didn't know the Sundays did that to people. Gully did.

panels.composition: Gully's. A TOURIST crouched to BARNABY II, her hand over her mouth. WOOD on the stool, alarmed. GULLY, not alarmed.

balloons.text: It's him. The box. The three— I read it in a hospital waiting room. I'm sorry. I'm sorry.

panels.composition: Wood. Not knowing what to do with his hands.

panels.composition: Gully handing the tourist a napkin and a coffee in one motion. Practiced.

balloons.text: Happens. Two bucks. Take your time.

balloons.text: Every August since '14. You're out. I'm here. It happens.
